title: [dynamo] sys.setrecursionlimit doesn't seem to do anything
error_description: This code gives RecursionError even though the recursionlimit was set to a very high value. If we don't compile, then we don't hit a recursion limit. If we set `tstate->c_recursion_remaining` to a high value as well somewhere in C dynamo, then we run successfully. So we should add some kind of eval_frame API to modify the C recursion limit.
